description: AGSC-04-05 as amended for 1.1: a Unicode noncharacter in authored text is the warning AGSC-E423 (RFC 7493 section 2.1 excludes noncharacters from I-JSON); nothing is refused and the character still reaches the artefacts unchanged. Derivation: one conforming concept is added to the minimal fixture whose body holds U+FDD0, the first of the noncharacters U+FDD0 to U+FDEF; the one finding is a warning on that file. Exit 0. The vector file writes the character as the escape \ufdd0 so that the file is itself valid I-JSON.
